1	# WA Dashboard
2	
3	Multi-user WhatsApp dashboard built with Next.js 16, Prisma 7, and Baileys.
4	
5	## Login
6	
7	| Role  | Email           | Password  |
8	|-------|-----------------|-----------|
9	| Admin | admin@admin.com | Admin1234 |
10	
11	> Ganti password setelah pertama kali login.
12	
13	## Menjalankan Server
14	
15	```bash
16	npm run dev
17	```
18	
19	Buka `http://localhost:3000`
20	
21	> **Catatan:** Koneksi pertama ke database remote membutuhkan waktu ~30 detik. Halaman akan loading sebentar setelah server pertama kali dinyalakan.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## Fitur
26	
27	### Admin
28	- Buat / hapus akun user
29	- Monitor semua WA numbers dari semua user
30	- Lihat statistik pesan (masuk/keluar)
31	
32	### User
33	- Tambah hingga **3 WA numbers** per akun
34	- Setiap nomor punya **API key unik**
35	- Setiap nomor punya **webhook URL** sendiri
36	- Tab per nomor: Connection, Send, Groups, Webhook, API
37	
38	---
39	
40	## API v1
41	
42	Base URL: `http://localhost:3000`
43	
44	Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key_nomor>`
45	
46	| Method | Endpoint           | Deskripsi                  |
47	|--------|--------------------|----------------------------|
48	| GET    | /api/v1/groups     | Daftar grup WA             |
49	| POST   | /api/v1/send/text  | Kirim pesan teks           |
50	| POST   | /api/v1/send/media | Kirim gambar/video/dokumen |
51	
52	**Kirim teks:**
53	```bash
54	curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/v1/send/text \
55	  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY_MU" \
56	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
57	  -d '{"to": "628123456789", "text": "Halo!"}'
58	```
59	
60	**Kirim ke grup:**
61	```bash
62	curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/v1/send/text \
63	  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY_MU" \
64	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
65	  -d '{"to": "120363xxxxxx@g.us", "text": "Halo grup!"}'
66	```
67	
68	**Kirim media:**
69	```bash
70	curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/v1/send/media \
71	  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY_MU" \
72	  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
73	  -d '{"to": "628123456789", "url": "https://...", "type": "image", "caption": "Caption"}'
74	```
75	
76	---
77	
78	## Webhook
79	
80	Setiap nomor bisa dikonfigurasi dengan webhook URL. Semua tipe pesan WA didukung.
81	
82	### Field umum (selalu ada)
83	```json
84	{
85	  "event": "message",
86	  "data": {
87	    "from": "628xxx@s.whatsapp.net",
88	    "fromMe": false,
89	    "id": "MSG_ID",
90	    "timestamp": 1234567890,
91	    "type": "conversation"
92	  }
93	}
94	```
95	
96	### Teks biasa (`conversation`, `extendedTextMessage`)
97	```json
98	{ "type": "conversation", "text": "Halo!" }
99	```
100	
101	### Gambar (`imageMessage`) / Video (`videoMessage`) / Stiker (`stickerMessage`)
102	```json
103	{
104	  "type": "imageMessage",
105	  "text": "caption jika ada",
106	  "media": {
107	    "url": "https://mmg.whatsapp.net/...",
108	    "mimetype": "image/jpeg",
109	    "fileSize": 123456
110	  }
111	}
112	```
113	> Video juga memiliki field `seconds`. Stiker memiliki field `isAnimated`.
114	
115	### Audio / Voice note (`audioMessage`)
116	```json
117	{
118	  "type": "audioMessage",
119	  "media": {
120	    "url": "https://mmg.whatsapp.net/...",
121	    "mimetype": "audio/ogg; codecs=opus",
122	    "seconds": 12,
123	    "ptt": true
124	  }
125	}
126	```
127	> `ptt: true` artinya voice note (Push To Talk).
128	
129	### Dokumen / File (`documentMessage`)
130	```json
131	{
132	  "type": "documentMessage",
133	  "text": "caption jika ada",
134	  "media": {
135	    "url": "https://mmg.whatsapp.net/...",
136	    "mimetype": "application/pdf",
137	    "filename": "dokumen.pdf",
138	    "fileSize": 204800,
139	    "title": "Judul dokumen"
140	  }
141	}
142	```
143	
144	### Lokasi / Maps (`locationMessage`, `liveLocationMessage`)
145	```json
146	{
147	  "type": "locationMessage",
148	  "location": {
149	    "latitude": -6.2088,
150	    "longitude": 106.8456,
151	    "name": "Nama tempat",
152	    "address": "Alamat lengkap",
153	    "isLive": false
154	  }
155	}
156	```
157	
158	### Kontak (`contactMessage`, `contactsArrayMessage`)
159	```json
160	{
161	  "type": "contactMessage",
162	  "contact": {
163	    "displayName": "John Doe",
164	    "vcard": "BEGIN:VCARD\nVERSION:3.0\n..."
165	  }
166	}
167	```
168	
169	---
170	
171	## Stack
172	
173	- **Framework:** Next.js 16.2.2 (App Router)
174	- **Database:** PostgreSQL via Prisma 7.6.0 + `@prisma/adapter-pg`
175	- **WhatsApp:** `@whiskeysockets/baileys`
176	- **Auth:** JWT (`jose`) + HTTP-only cookie
177	- **Password:** bcryptjs (cost factor 12)
178

1	# JVTO WhatsApp Operations — Pemetaan Situasi
2	
3	**Tanggal:** 15 Mei 2026
4	**Sumber:** awal_brainstorming.txt + konteks operasional JVTO
5	**Tujuan dokumen:** Memetakan situasi — permasalahan, yang ingin dibangun, dan yang sudah dimiliki — secara deskriptif
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Bagian 1: Permasalahan
10	
11	### 1.1 Antarmuka Komunikasi
12	
13	WhatsApp adalah antarmuka utama JVTO ke pihak luar. Semua percakapan — customer, B2B partner, vendor, crew — berjalan melalui aplikasi ini. Tidak ada pemisahan inbox per fungsi. Satu nomor menampung semuanya.
14	
15	### 1.2 Lima Fungsi yang Berjalan di Satu Channel
16	
17	Lima fungsi berbeda yang saat ini berjalan di satu inbox WhatsApp:
18	
19	| Fungsi | Audiens | Stage |
20	|---|---|---|
21	| Sales | Calon tamu yang belum booking (JVTO direct inquiry) | Pre-sale |
22	| Concierge | Tamu yang sudah bayar via JVTO direct | Post-booking → in-tour → post-tour |
23	| Service Desk | Tamu yang booking via Klook | Booked (sudah bayar di platform) |
24	| Account Management B2B | The Window Travel (agent Malaysia) | B2B partnership |
25	| Internal Operations | Hotel, restaurant, driver, guide | Operasional eksekusi |
26	
27	Setiap fungsi memiliki:
28	- Tone berbeda
29	- Otoritas berbeda (siapa boleh memutuskan apa)
30	- SLA berbeda
31	- Ekspektasi customer berbeda
32	
33	### 1.3 Penanganan Operasional
34	
35	Lima fungsi tersebut ditangani oleh satu staf (Inan). Inan adalah single point of failure operasional — bus factor = 1.
36	
37	Kondisi:
38	- Tidak ada staf cadangan terdokumentasi
39	- Tidak ada playbook tertulis (sebelum dokumen WAOL Mei 2026)
40	- Tidak ada proses onboarding cepat untuk staf pengganti
41	- Sam tidak punya visibilitas operasional tanpa bertanya ke Inan
42	
43	### 1.4 Pola Respons Off-Hours
44	
45	Tamu Eropa kirim pesan jam 02:00 WIB sering tidak terbalas sampai 08:00 WIB. Selisih 6 jam. Untuk standar respons profesional pasar Eropa, pola ini terbaca sebagai signal kurangnya profesionalisme.
46	
47	### 1.5 Infrastruktur WhatsApp Gateway
48	
49	WA Pro CRM yang dibangun David adalah WhatsApp gateway non-resmi (bukan Meta Cloud API official). Konsekuensi yang teridentifikasi dalam sesi:
50	- Nomor bisnis JVTO punya risiko di-ban kalau pola pengiriman terlalu agresif atau pola pesan terbaca botty oleh Meta

1	Below is a proposed **SKILL.md** for a JVTO support workflow where you often ask AI to draft a reply, then manually check whether the package URL, policy, dates, inclusions, and assumptions are correct.
2	
3	````markdown
4	# JVTO Verified Customer Reply Skill
5	
6	## Description
7	
8	This skill generates customer-facing JVTO replies and verifies them before output.
9	
10	It is designed for customer support situations where the assistant must:
11	1. Understand the customer’s request.
12	2. Match the request to an existing JVTO package or policy.
13	3. Generate a short, professional reply for WhatsApp or email.
14	4. Verify that the reply does not contain unsupported claims, wrong links, wrong package names, invented prices, or incorrect policy details.
15	
16	The goal is to reduce manual checking after AI drafts a response.
17	
18	---
19	
20	## When to Trigger
21	
22	Use this skill when the user asks for help replying to a JVTO customer, especially when the message includes:
23	
24	### Package Recommendation
25	Examples:
26	- “Customer wants Bromo and Ijen 3D2N, suggest a package.”
27	- “They start from Bali and finish in Surabaya, what should we reply?”
28	- “Customer asks for Tumpak Sewu, Bromo, and Ijen.”
29	
30	### Booking / Payment / Deposit Questions
31	Examples:
32	- “Customer asks if they can pay later.”
33	- “Explain 20% deposit and balance payment.”
34	- “Payment failed, ask if they need another method.”
35	
36	### Pickup / Drop-off / Timing
37	Examples:
38	- “Customer arrives at Surabaya station at 10:30, can we pick up?”
39	- “They want to finish in Bali, explain ferry and transfer.”
40	- “Ask for flight details.”
41	
42	### Policy / Safety / Weather / Blue Fire
43	Examples:
44	- “Customer asks about cancellation due to flight changes.”
45	- “Explain Blue Fire cannot be guaranteed.”
46	- “Customer asks if rain affects the tour.”
47	
48	### Customization / Route Changes
49	Examples:
50	- “Customer wants to replace Madakaripura with Tumpak Sewu.”

## 2. Key Files Analyzed

**Configuration:**
- `D:/wa-dashboard/package.json:1-50` — Next.js 16, Prisma 7, Baileys, bcryptjs, jose (JWT), pino logging
- `D:/wa-dashboard/tsconfig.json:1-34` — Target ES2017, React 19, path alias `@/*`
- `D:/wa-dashboard/README.md:1-178` — JVTO WhatsApp dashboard (multi-user, 3 WA numbers/user, webhooks, API v1)
- `D:/wa-dashboard/prisma/schema.prisma:1-247` — 14 models: User, WaNumber, MessageLog, Contact, Pipeline, Template, JvtoCrmContact, etc.

**Core Libraries:**
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/lib/wa-client.ts:1-600` — Baileys WhatsApp singleton, QR generation, message parsing, webhook dispatch
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/lib/jvto-utils.ts:1-39` — Phone normalization, JVTO customer detection (non-Indonesian, non-group)
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/lib/auth.ts` — JWT session validation
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/lib/db.ts` — Prisma client singleton

**API Endpoints (Sample):**
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/app/api/jvto/chat/route.ts:1-56` — GET message history paginated (30/page)
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/app/api/jvto/customers/route.ts:1-32` — Fetch JVTO customers from legacy API
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/app/api/jvto/crm/[customerId]/route.ts:1-86` — CRM contact GET/PATCH (pipeline, labels, notes)
- `D:/wa-dashboard/src/app/api/jvto/send/route.ts:1-63` — Send WhatsApp message to JVTO customer

---

## 3. Package Dependencies (Relevant)

```json
"@whiskeysockets/baileys": "^7.0.0-rc.9" — WhatsApp gateway (Baileys)
"@prisma/client": "^7.6.0" — ORM
"jose": "^6.2.2" — JWT signing/verification
"bcryptjs": "^3.0.3" — Password hashing
"pino": "^10.3.1" — Logging
"dotenv": "^17.4.0" — .env parsing
"qrcode": "^1.5.4" — QR code generation
"@radix-ui/*": "*" — UI components
```

No direct AI/LLM integrations found (no openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama imports).

---

## 4. Data Model (Prisma Schema)

**Core Tables:**
- `User` — email, password, role (ADMIN|USER), isJvto flag, apiKey
- `WaNumber` — phone number, authDir, webhookUrl, connectionActiveAt heartbeat
- `MessageLog` — direction (IN/OUT), toFrom (normalized phone), content, mediaType, mediaData (JSON), createdAt index
- `Contact` — phone, name, notes, customFields (JSON), labels, pipelineStage
- `JvtoCrmContact` — jvtoCustomerId (unique), pipelineStage, labels, notes, reminders
- `Template` — name, content, variables (for variable substitution)
- `Label`, `PipelineStage`, `Reminder`, `ContactNote`, `JvtoCrmNote`, `TemplateVariable`

**Indexes:** createdAt, toFrom (MessageLog); pipelineStageId, waNumberId (Contact)

---

## 5. How It Gets Context for WhatsApp Conversations

**Current state: NO AI/LLM integration yet.**

### Knowledge Base (Raw/)
The `Raw/` directory contains prepared context documents:
- `JVTO_Pemetaan_Situasi_2026-05-15.md` — Situation mapping (5 functions: Sales, Concierge, ServiceDesk, B2B, Internal)
- `JVTO_Verified_Customer_Reply_Skill.md` — Skill framework for drafting verified replies (package recommendations, booking, policy)
- `JVTO_Destination_Package_Duration_Verifier.md` — Package routing rules
- `JVTO_Corporate_Authority_Pricing_Route_Verifier.md` — Pricing & corporate policies
- `JVTO_Refund_And_Adjustment_Automation_v2.md` — Refund & discount automation
- `JVTO_Verified_Package_Response_Generator.md` — Template response generator
- `API_Documentation_JVTO.pdf` — Legacy API spec

### Context Pipeline (Manual)
1. **Message receipt** → Baileys webhook → `MessageLog` table (direction IN/OUT, toFrom, content)
2. **Contact lookup** → Query `Contact` by toFrom, get name, notes, customFields, labels
3. **JVTO customer mapping** → Query `JvtoCrmContact` by jvtoCustomerId → pipeline, labels, notes
4. **Manual reply drafting** → Staff uses Raw/ knowledge docs to verify package URLs, pricing, policy

**No automated context injection to LLM yet.** Waiting for AI assistant integration.

---

## 6. Current Features

**Admin:**
- Create/delete user accounts
- Monitor all WA numbers across users
- View message statistics

**User:**
- Connect up to 3 WA numbers per account (QR-based Baileys auth)
- Unique API key per number
- Custom webhook URL per number
- Manage contacts (CRUD, notes, labels, pipeline stage)
